functional.statement: As summarised from the original paper (not performed by 37342083): increased IκBα degradation and p65 phosphorylation in the patient's samples and in vitro in THP-1 cells. Controls not given in this source.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense substitution, p.(Thr602Ser), in ZnF4 per 37342083 (from the batch HGVS and Table 2). The paper describes HA20 as caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants.

quotes.quote: AbstractA20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is an autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variations in TNFAIP3, the gene encoding the A20 protein.

To better assess the impact of the localization of TNFAIP3 missense variations on A20 protein function, we reviewed all missense variations reported to date that are shared with the scientific community as original articles or conference abstracts, including the variation herein identified (Table 2).

concerns: The variant appears only in a review table and text (37342083) summarising Jiang et al., 2022; the primary case report is not among the batch papers. Every item here is second-hand.
Table cells in 37342083 Table 2 are read by column position (column 11 = c.1804A>T); the quotes are row fragments, so the panel should confirm the column in the original table.
37342083 is internally inconsistent on the classification wording (Table 2 vs Discussion text).
37342083 reports CADD 2.206 for this variant alongside the functional summary; the primary paper may give its own in-silico results.
Index case's sex is not given in 37342083.
Transcript: 37342083 uses NM_006290; the batch uses NM_001270508.2 (protein_check: agrees).
notes_for_panel: Second-hand evidence only, from a review table. Retrieving the primary report (Jiang et al., 2022) would let the panel check the functional assays and family data directly.
